title: OL-PR-812: land or supersede pull request #812 (needs-pat)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** lane pass: pull request #812 is needs-pat
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation loopowner --closed 812
**Status:** closed

SERVER-OWNS-LOOPS-1: the server owns pull request #812 (`claude/cf-posture-uploads-a9c57f` at 6d94a6e855, opened by rwnq8): CF-POSTURE-2, COST-PROBE-FIELD-1: every upload path keeps logs on; daily cost guard runs again. The session that opened it is not its closer and is never asked to act. The pull request changes .github/workflows/** and no workflow-capable credential is bound (foundation/data/needs-you.json, lane-credential). Land every file outside .github/workflows/ in a separate pull request now, so only the workflow change is left behind the credential. Files (11): .github/workflows/cost-guard.yml, deploy/cost-probe.mjs, doctrine/cf-posture.json, doctrine/writeback/lesson-2026-11-20-cf-posture-2-the-deploy-gateway-and-four-more-upload-paths-a.json, foundation/cfposture.py, scripts/cf_account.py, test/cost-probe.test.mjs, workers/adapters/cloudflare/deployer.js, workers/adapters/cloudflare/install-adapter.js, workers/apps/launcher/src/provision.js, workers/core/deploygate/index.js.

**Prediction:** open_prs <= 0 within 24 h
**Out of scope:** changing what pull request #812 does; land it as written or carry it onto main unchanged.

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation loopowner --closed 812` exits 0 (pull request #812 is merged or closed).

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-20T20:00:50Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 22.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T04:21:15Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: pull request is merged
